"""Scratch check of the visible half: each source's heading found at its stated first line, and its span."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from gov.retrieval.measure import _span

ROOT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-61")
for file in sorted((ROOT / "fixtures/evaluation/memory-retrieval/visible").glob("*.yaml")):
    data = yaml.safe_load(file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for entry in data["sources"]:
        for alt in entry if isinstance(entry, list) else [entry]:
            span = _span(alt, ROOT, "visible", data["id"])
            stated = tuple(alt.get("lines") or ())
            lines = (ROOT / alt["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            found = next((i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.rstrip() == str(alt.get("heading", "")).rstrip()), None)
            flag = "OK " if found == (stated[0] if stated else None) and span == stated else "CHK"
            print(flag, data["id"], alt["path"], "found", found, "stated", stated, "span", span)
sys.exit(0)
